facts.text: Jolene traveled to a meditation retreat in Phuket with her partner for a few weeks during the weekend before 12 September 2023.

evidence.quote: Last weekend my partner and I traveled to a meditation retreat for a few weeks in Phuket.

facts.text: Jolene reflected on what makes her happy at the meditation retreat and realized the importance of incorporating relaxation, self-care, and balance in her life alongside her engineering studies.

evidence.quote: It made me realize the importance of incorporating relaxation, self-care, and balance in life alongside my engineering studies.

facts.text: Jolene mentioned that a session at the retreat about releasing expectations and judgments and savoring the present stood out to her.

evidence.quote: The one session that really stood out was about releasing expectations and judgments and just savoring the present.
